mechanism: Fluoxetine inhibits CYP2D6, increasing fluphenazine levels and risk of extrapyramidal side effects and QT prolongation; additive CNS depression and serotonergic activity.
action: Monitor closely for extrapyramidal symptoms, QT prolongation, and serotonin syndrome; consider dose reduction of fluphenazine or alternative antipsychotic with lower CYP2D6 metabolism.
